task.title: Starting a mirroring synchronization
task.shortdesc: To start a mirroring sync immediately in Red Hat Quay, you can open the Mirroring tab for your repository or organization and click Sync Now.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Mirroring tab of your repository or organization.

ol.li: Click the Logs tab to view available logs.
When mirroring is complete, the images appear in the Tags tab.
